routes.summary: Whether the API and its database are working

200.description: Everything works.

routes.summary: The relays apps connect through and the oldest app version still served

200.description: The network settings. Cacheable for five minutes; apps keep the last copy they read for when the API cannot be reached.

429.description: Too many requests from this address.

routes.summary: A one-time value for a device to sign before it registers

200.description: The challenge, valid for two minutes.

routes.summary: Add a device to your account, or update it

200.description: The device was already yours and is updated.

routes.summary: Your devices

200.description: Your devices, newest first.

routes.summary: Take one of your devices off your account, from the phone, the web app or the app on one of your hosts

204.description: The device is no longer on your account.

routes.summary: Rename one of your devices or hosts, from the phone, the web app or the app on one of your hosts

200.description: The device under its new name. Every device hears device.changed.

404.description: None of your devices has that key.

routes.summary: Deliver this phone's notifications to a push token

200.description: The token is stored, replacing the phone's earlier one. A token another phone had moves to this one.

400.description: The challenge is unknown, used or expired, or this server does not deliver to that app or APNs environment.

403.description: The signature does not prove the phone holds its key.

404.description: None of your phones has that key.

routes.summary: Stop delivering notifications to this phone

204.description: The phone has no push token, whether or not it had one.

404.description: None of your phones has that key.

routes.summary: A ticket for this phone to join one of your hosts without a code

200.description: The ticket, good for ten minutes. The host still asks its owner before letting the phone in.

404.description: None of your phones has that key, or none of your hosts has the host's.

429.description: More than 10 tickets for this phone in a minute.

routes.summary: Start signing in a host that has no browser, such as a server reached over SSH

201.description: The codes, good for ten minutes. The host shows the user code and asks every interval seconds whether it was approved.

429.description: Too many sign-ins from this address.

routes.summary: Whether the person approved this host yet

200.description: Pending, or approved with the account and a challenge to sign.

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

429.description: Asked more often than the interval allows.

routes.summary: Register the approved host on the account, proving it holds its key

200.description: The host was already on the account and is updated. The code is used up.

201.description: The host is on the account. The code is used up.

400.description: The challenge is unknown, used or expired.

403.description: The signature does not prove the host holds its key.

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

409.description: The key is registered to another account, or as a phone.

routes.summary: The host waiting behind a user code, to check before approving it

200.description: The waiting host.

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

routes.summary: Add the waiting host to your account

204.description: Approved. The host finishes on its next ask.

403.description: The sign-in was not verified again within the error's reverifyWithinMinutes (message reverify).

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

routes.summary: Add the waiting host to your account from the app on another of your hosts, which read the code over SSH

200.description: Approved, naming the host. It finishes on its next ask.

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

routes.summary: Refuse the waiting host

204.description: Refused. The host hears the code is gone.

404.description: The code is unknown, was refused, or has expired.

routes.summary: One connection per device that pushes account events as they happen

101.description: The connection is open. The server sends a challenge; the device answers with hello within 10 seconds. Its close codes are LiveCloseCode.

429.description: Too many connections from this address.

routes.summary: Whether your account is in use or waiting to be deleted

200.description: The account's status. A deleted account still answers, so an app can offer to restore it.

routes.summary: Delete your account and take every device off it

202.description: The account is deleted here and its devices revoked; the sign-in is deleted in Clerk at deletesAt unless the account is restored first. Repeating the call answers the same way. Revoking Sign in with Apple is tried once, and the deletion goes ahead whether or not it works.

400.description: The body is not a valid AccountDeletionRequest.

403.description: The sign-in was not verified again within the error's reverifyWithinMinutes (message reverify).

routes.summary: Take back a deletion before it is final

200.description: The account is in use again, with no devices on it; each signs in again. Restoring an account in use changes nothing.

404.description: The sign-in is already deleted in Clerk, so the account can no longer be restored.

routes.summary: The name, email and picture of the account a host is on

200.description: The profile, read from the account's sign-in.

routes.summary: Stash a link, text or file on your account

201.description: Stashed. A link's preview follows in a stash.changed event once the server has read the page.

400.description: The body is not a valid StashAdd, or a file's headers are missing or malformed.

413.description: The file is over 25 MB, or the account's stash would be over 1 GB (message names which).

routes.summary: Your stash, newest first

200.description: A page of up to 100 items; taken defaults to false.

routes.summary: Mark the stash seen up to a time, on every device

200.description: The stash's seen time as it now stands, which is later than the one sent when another device already marked a later one. A stash.seen event follows when it moved.

400.description: The body is not a valid StashSeen.

routes.summary: One stashed item

200.description: The item.

404.description: No item with that id is on your account.

routes.summary: A stashed item's file

200.description: The file's bytes, with its Content-Type and its name in Content-Disposition.

404.description: No item with a file has that id on your account.

routes.summary: Change an item's note, or mark it taken

200.description: The item as it is now. Marking a taken item taken again keeps its first takenAt.

400.description: The body is not a valid StashUpdate, or asks to untake an item.

404.description: No item with that id is on your account.

routes.summary: Delete a stashed item and its file

204.description: Deleted, or it was already gone.

routes.summary: Clerk telling the API a user was deleted in its dashboard

204.description: Handled, or not an event the API acts on.

401.description: The Svix signature is missing, wrong or too old.

503.description: The API has no webhook secret, so it accepts no webhooks.

routes.summary: Give this host a webhook address that reaches it wherever it is

409.description: The host already has as many webhooks as it may.

routes.summary: Take one of this host's webhooks away, with the requests it still holds

204.description: Removed, or it was already gone.

routes.summary: A sender's request to a host's webhook, held until the host takes it

404.description: No webhook has this address.

429.description: Over 60 requests a minute to this webhook, or its host already has as many requests waiting as it may.

routes.summary: The same as a POST, for senders that PUT

404.description: No webhook has this address.

429.description: Over 60 requests a minute to this webhook, or its host already has as many requests waiting as it may.

routes.summary: The same as a POST, for senders that PATCH

404.description: No webhook has this address.

429.description: Over 60 requests a minute to this webhook, or its host already has as many requests waiting as it may.

routes.summary: One connection per host with webhooks, carrying the requests they receive

101.description: The connection is open. The server sends a challenge; the host answers with hello within 10 seconds. Its close codes are HookCloseCode.

429.description: Too many connections from this address.

routes.summary: One connection per host publishing shared chats, and one per viewer watching one

101.description: The connection is open. The server sends a challenge; the client answers with hello within 10 seconds. Its close codes are ShareCloseCode.

429.description: Too many connections from this address.

routes.summary: The account's vault as this host sees it: its entries, the key sealed for this host, and the hosts still waiting for it

200.description: The vault, or null when the account has none yet.

routes.summary: Make the account's vault, with its key sealed for this host and for the recovery key

201.description: The vault, at generation 1. Every host hears vault.changed.

409.description: The account already has a vault.

routes.summary: Seal the vault key for hosts on the account: a holder for any of them, a host restoring the vault from its recovery key only for itself

200.description: The vault with the new holders. Every host hears vault.changed.

400.description: A key is for a device that is not a host on the account.

403.description: This host does not hold the key at that generation, and the keys are not only for itself.

404.description: The account has no vault.

409.description: The generation is not the current one.

routes.summary: Replace the vault key, sealing every entry again under the new one

200.description: The vault at the next generation. Every host hears vault.changed.

400.description: A key is for a device that is not a host on the account, or leaves out this host.

403.description: This host does not hold the key at that generation.

404.description: The account has no vault.

409.description: The generation is not the current one, or the entries are not every current entry at its current revision.

routes.summary: Add an entry to the vault, or replace one

200.description: The entry as it is now. Every host hears vault.changed.

404.description: The account has no vault.

409.description: The revision is not the entry's current one, the generation is not current, or the vault already holds 500 entries.

routes.summary: Take an entry out of the vault

404.description: No entry with that id is in the vault.

409.description: The revision is not the entry's current one.

routes.summary: Report the uses this host's agents made of the vault's entries
Which agents on which hosts used the vault's entries in the last 30 days

200.description: Up to 500 uses, the most recent first.
